name: epwforge-mcp
description: Weather files (EPW/DDY) for building energy simulation, on-demand. Four tools: search the 17,000-station catalog, analyze any EPW (design conditions, HDD/CDD, DesignDay IDF emit), render 5 chart types (diurnal, wind rose, temp carpet, monthly box plot, comparison), and generate TMY/AMY/CMIP6-morphed
